notes: The tutorial allows any analog sensor; the circuit image and schematic show a potentiometer, so that is what was built.

In the image the potentiometer's wiper pin is on the top half of the breadboard in column 12 (yellow wire in the same column strip). Its outer legs are in columns 11 and 13 on the bottom half. I placed the wiper at 12t.f and the yellow wire at 12t.g.
The black wire goes to the GND pin in the Uno power header. I used GND.1 because the image doesn't make clear which of the two GND pins it is.
The potentiometer outer legs are interchangeable (GND=VCC). I took GND from the black wire's column and 5V from the red wire's column, as in the image.
Wire 1 (red) carries 5V, wire 2 (black) carries GND and wire 3 (yellow) carries the wiper signal to A0. The USB cable to the PC is not drawn in the circuit, so I left it out.
